summary: Short kerb beside a junction; homes 16 m away, cars stop nearby.
reasons: Cars stop along the kerb just south
Only 13 m, close to a junction

best_section.where: east kerb of Taringa Parade just south of the side-street junction

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwelling 16 m away, with others 39 m and further; the corner verge is open grass and trees.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb with a few vehicles parked along it just south; room beside the lane is probably enough for a van but the stretch is short.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a side-street junction at the north end.
drivers.convention: Vehicles park along the east kerb to the south, but no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Trees along the east side shade the south end; the north end is open.
